chunks: Al-Husayn b. Ibrahim b. Natana (may Allah have mercy on him) narrated to us. He said: Ali b. Ibrahim narrated to us from his father from al-Husayn b. Yazid al-Nawfali from Ismail b. Muslim al-Sukuni from al-Sadiq Jafar b. Muhammad from his father from his forefathers from Ali (peace be upon them). He said:

The Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and his family) taught me that whenever I put on a new garment, I should say: "Praise be to Allah who clothed me in fine clothing by which I beautify myself among the people. O Allah, make it a garment of blessing in which I strive for Your pleasure and build Your mosques." For whoever does that will not wear it except that he is forgiven.

key_terms.الرياش: fine clothing, luxurious garments — the word carries connotations of beauty and adornment
key_terms.بمرضاتك: for Your pleasure — seeking Allah's satisfaction in one's actions
key_terms.ثياب بركة: garments of blessing — clothing sanctified through supplication

ai.seo_question: What supplication did the Prophet teach Imam Ali to say when wearing new clothes?
ai.summary: This hadith, narrated through Imam Ali from the Prophet Muhammad, teaches a specific supplication to be recited when wearing new clothing. The prayer expresses gratitude for the blessing of fine garments, and asks Allah to make the clothing a source of blessing through which one strives for divine pleasure and serves mosques. The promise of forgiveness for whoever recites this supplication reflects the Islamic principle of sanctifying daily actions through remembrance of God.
word_analysis: may He have mercy on him
